teaching.title: Two-speed memory
teaching.body: Every employee keeps memory at two speeds: a raw append-only journal written each session, and a small curated long-term file rewritten weekly by compressing those journals. It works because the agent re-reads the whole long-term file every session — only possible because distillation keeps it small. Notes that only ever grow become notes nobody re-reads.
